name: Nacira
source:
A visual novel based on an ancient Javanese kingdom with a comedic tone, where you can play as the heroine, Nacira.

Your choices will lead you into one of the five endings with the kingdom's princes: Puntadewa, Werkudara, Arjuna, Sadewa & Nakula (a.k.a. Pandawa lima).

The story is about a woman named Nacira Basita, who was invited to be a substitute dancer for the next King ceremony in Nirwasita Kingdom. She has to live in the palace a month before her performance day.

There, she finds a mysterious box with a letter from the previous dancer, Nyikara, and directed to her lover. 
Later, Arjuna challenges her to guess Nyikara's lover in six days.

Can Nacira solves the mystery and find out about the one Nyikara loves all along? Or will she grow closer with the Pandawa princes instead and find her own love?

[Edited from [url=http://vnnacira.weebly.com/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
一部以古代爪哇王国为背景的视觉小说，带有喜剧基调，你可以在其中扮演女主角纳西拉。

你的选择将引导你进入王国王子的五个结局之一：Puntadewa、Werkudara、Arjuna、Sadewa和Nakula（又名Pandawa lima）。

故事讲述的是一位名叫纳西拉·巴斯塔 (Nacira Basita) 的女子，她被邀请担任尼尔瓦西塔王国下一届国王仪式的替补舞者。她必须在演出日前一个月住在宫殿里。

在那里，她发现了一个神秘的盒子，里面有一封前舞者尼卡拉写给她情人的信。
后来，阿朱那挑战她在六天内猜出尼卡拉的情人。

纳西拉能否解开谜团并找出尼卡拉一直深爱的人呢？或者她会与潘达瓦王子变得更加亲密并找到自己的爱情吗？

[编辑自[url=http://vnnacira.weebly.com/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
